text:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: p99 decode latency spike detected on prod-gpu-pool-2. Threshold 1200ms breached. Auto-mitigation not available.

alex: seeing large number of streaming stalls and blocked tails. p95 jumped from ~120ms -> 2.3s across requests to model-rw-13b. p99 ~6.2s.

maria: ugh. Any recent infra or runtime changes pushed to that pool?

devon: pushed kernel build trt-8.1.2+flashattn-2.0 to the pool during the 00:10 deploy window (build artifact: kernel-2141589000). We've had quieter perf in staging but not this.

lee: logs show repeated paging and KV-cache evictions around the same time:
```
E decode: evicting kv cache for session 0x7f3a, page faults rising
E mem: pager reclaimed 312MB in 120s
```

jordan: customer impact: Acme Payments is reporting streaming stalls and partial responses for about 20% of requests the last 15m. Support ticket opened.

alex: hypothesis: new kernel + updated FlashAttention kernels increase memory pressure and change codegen for the decode path, leading to paging at tail lengths > 1024.

maria: can we measure sequence-length distribution and correlate with p99? alex, do you have a quick query?

alex: run this on observability: `sum(rate(decode_latency_seconds_bucket{pool="prod-gpu-pool-2"}[5m])) by (le)` — early look shows tail traffic concentrated at seq_len 1100-1800.

devon: thinking mitigation options: 1) rollback kernel to kernel-2141500000 (pre-trt-8.1.2), 2) hotpatch compiler flags to disable aggressive f32->f16 fusion, 3) evict/limit long-seq sessions via routing. Rollback is fastest to test.

jordan: +1 rollback. Need owner for rollback and customer comms. I'll start the incident ticket and ping support.

ops-bot: creating incident INC-3421 and paging oncall.

devon: initiating rollback to kernel-2141500000 on a small canary subset (nodes n-prod-gpu-21..23) now. Command: `infra-tool rollback-kernel --pool prod-gpu-pool-2 --image kernel-2141500000 --nodes n-prod-gpu-21,n-prod-gpu-22,n-prod-gpu-23 --graceful`

lee: monitoring memory and tail latencies on canary. If we see p99 drop, expand.

oncall-bot: deploy bot: started kernel rollback job job_id=rb-2141592701. Estimated per-node restart 45s.

alex: can we add a temporary route filter to send seq_len > 1024 traffic to older pool (prod-gpu-pool-1) until rollback completes? That reduces customer impact quickly.

maria: ops-team ok with routing rule, but need to confirm capacity on pool-1. Jordan, can you check capacity?

jordan: pool-1 has ~30% spare capacity. I'll add route rule: `routingctl update --if seq_len>1024 --target prod-gpu-pool-1 --rate-limit 200rps`

ops-bot: route update applied.

lee: canary nodes showing immediate improvement: p95 down to 170ms, p99 down to 650ms on canary. No paging spikes.

devon: expanding rollback to remaining nodes in pool-2 in batches of 5 with 2m wait between batches.

maria: good. Jordan, please draft a short customer notification: cause (kernel change), mitigation (rollback + routing), ETA for full remediation (T+30m). Keep it concise.

jordan: posting to support: "We're rolling back a kernel patch that affected decode memory usage; temporary routing added for long sequences. Expect full recovery within 30-45 minutes. We'll update in 15-minute intervals."

sre-bot: SLOs: p95 and p99 for prod-gpu-pool-2 breached between 2141592400-2141593000. Recorded customer error-rate spike of 12% for streaming endpoints. Incident severity set to sev2.

alex: devon — can you also capture diff of compile flags that landed in 8.1.2 build? We need a root cause note.

devon: yes. diff: `-DCOMPILE_OPT=O3 -DENABLE_FUSED_ATTENTION -funsafe-math-optimizations` -> `+DCOMPILE_OPT=O2 -DDISABLE_FUSED_ATTENTION -fno-unsafe-math` for patched build. I'll attach full build log to the ticket.

lee: note: FlashAttention kernel path now uses larger temporary buffers; combined with our alloc pattern it pushed resident set up above soft limit triggering pager thrash.

maria: remediation plan: 1) full rollback to pre-TRT build for pool-2 (in progress), 2) audit compile flags for future builds and add staging perf test for long-seq tails, 3) create canary policy to hold kernel changes off production until we pass tail latency bench.

devon: will file PR for the compile flag gating and add an eval that simulates seq_len 1500 streaming load.

ops-bot: rollback job rb-2141592701 completed on canary nodes. Batch rollout continuing.

lee: monitoring shows pool-wide p95 ~140ms, p99 ~420ms and falling. Memory reclaim rates normalized.

jordan: updated customer note with recovery: "We see improved latencies after rollback; continuing to monitor. Full verification expected within 30m."

alex: handoff: Maria, I'm handing off active ops to you for the next shift. Action items in INC-3421: verify remaining nodes, confirm support communications, and schedule postmortem.

maria: taking it. Leaving checklist: 1) confirm all nodes rolled, 2) confirm no regressions in other pools, 3) schedule 1hr postmortem with runtime/dev oncall.

oncall-bot: :white_check_mark: Incident INC-3421 status: mitigation in progress, primary mitigations applied (rollback + routing). Severity sev2.

jordan: thx team. I'll keep support updated. If anything regresses ping me and @maria.
